name: Omar Farouk
occupation: IT support engineer at a telecom company in Doha
background: Egyptian, has lived in Doha for four years. Single. Earns QAR 11,000 a month and wants to save around QAR 3,000 of it each month.
stated_goal: Wants to start saving some of his salary each month.
personality: Polite and careful. Asks what things mean before agreeing. Answers briefly unless the question is specific.

hidden_needs.topic: banking preferences, especially religious or ethical ones about interest or Islamic / Sharia-compliant products
hidden_needs.fact: He will not use any product that pays or charges interest; it must be Sharia-compliant.

hidden_needs.topic: what he is saving for, his plans or goals, and when he will need the money
hidden_needs.fact: He wants to buy a car for about QAR 60,000 in roughly 18 months.

hidden_needs.topic: money he sends to family abroad or other people he supports financially
hidden_needs.fact: He sends QAR 2,500 every month to his mother in Cairo.
